description: Source code for game information management in Unvanquished, including parsing arena info, loading arena files, and managing map lists.

methods.name: CG_ParseInfos
methods.description: Parses arena information from text input and populates arena list.

methods.name: CG_LoadArenasFromFile
methods.description: Loads arena data from a specified file, supports legacy format.

methods.name: CG_LoadArenas
methods.description: Loads arena data for a given map, including fallback to multiple directories and scripts.

methods.name: CG_GetArenaInfo
methods.description: Retrieves arena information for a specific map name.

methods.name: CG_LoadMapList
methods.description: Loads and sorts the list of available maps.
